steps.action: Complete the formal task candidate and its content-owned terminal/release-ready gates.
Push the task branch and verify its exact remote SHA.
Run deterministic Current, semantic, lifecycle, lineage and scoped regression gates before main publication.
Optionally exercise ref-check logic against the candidate without claiming formal main publication.
Fast-forward formal main to the exact candidate SHA.
Fresh-fetch and create a clean checkout of the published formal main.
Observe git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main and require candidate == remote == fresh clone HEAD.
Run the post-publication validator and Current semantic gates on the fresh main checkout.
Write the publication witness, machine receipt and human result to the 1111 receipt branch.
Return 1111_RELAY_UPDATED only after formal main and the receipt witness are independently verified.

pre_publication_hard_gates.claim_ceiling: Release admission contract and repository-local evidence wiring only; no external truth, production readiness, Owner acceptance or epistemic acceptance is inferred.

failure_policy: Do not report success when remote-ref or Current semantic witness fails.
Do not rewind formal main or force push to hide a failed witness.
Allow only a new ordinary repair commit or explicit Owner decision after a failed publication witness.
A receipt write must not create a new formal commit or change the witnessed formal main SHA.
claim_ceiling: This protocol governs repository-local release sequencing and evidence; it does not establish external truth, production readiness, Owner acceptance or epistemic acceptance.
